messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy paused for release v1.32.0 (r-2026-04-31) due to incident INC-2026-04. All pending canaries held.

maria: Confirmed. Holding tonight's rollout and any automated cutovers. Ops: what's ETA on the incident mitigation?

doug: ops-oncall is on it, root cause looks like a replica lag storm on EU/1, working mitigation now. ETA ~45m to 1h.

ops-oncall: DB team has a mitigation running (read-only reroute + replay throttles). Will update in 10m.

elena: Quick question — does v1.32 include any schema or migration steps? If so we should pin.

simon: No schema changes in v1.32 — it's mostly runtime kvcache fix + kernel tweak for batching. Safe to pin control-plane to previous image while we wait.

maria: OK. Plan: pin control-plane -> v1.31.9 for now, keep canary buckets closed. Move prod window from 23:00 UTC to 02:00 UTC to give ops time to validate post-incident. If DB latency > +20% during canary, auto-rollback.

maria: I'll update the release notes and the deployment config. Pinned images (for ops/infra):
```
control-plane: sha256:abcdef1234567890
runtime: sha256:123456abcdef7890
canary-policy: enabled=false
```

doug: Please add a short rollback playbook excerpt to the release notes (commands + who to notify). Tagging support: @sre-support.

maria: Will do. Drafting release note change now and will post the updated changelog link here when ready. Also creating a follow-up incident checklist entry to track any regressions from the kernel tweak.

elena: Adding canary thresholds: latency_p50 < +10%, error_rate < 0.5% for 15m. If breached -> immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan updated: canary hold applied, control-plane pinned to v1.31.9, new change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rollback trigger configured (latency/error thresholds).

ops-oncall: DB looks stable for now, tails coming down. Will confirm 02:00 readiness ~01:45 UTC.

simon: Thanks team. Once maria posts the updated notes I'll push the new deployment config to staging for one final smoke run.

maria: Updated notes: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/r-2026-04-31 (edited) — includes pinned versions and rollback snippet. Will follow up if timeline changes. :thumbsup:
